Snacks

Strawberry cottage cheese bites

Túrós falatok

12 months+ Replaced 60 min 6 portions

Offer from twelve months, now and then, not every day. There is no chocolate and no coating.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 200 g Cottage cheese (Pasteurized; drained if watery)
  • 80 g Strawberries (Hulled and mashed)

Allergens

milk

Method

  1. Mash the strawberries.
  2. Stir them through the cottage cheese.
  3. Spoon small mounds onto a plate.
  4. Chill until they hold a soft shape, about 45 minutes.
  5. Serve with a spoon or as a soft bite, with nothing coated on the outside.

Replaced

The chocolate bar was the problem. Chocolate and a sugar shell do not belong here.

Mix soft pasteurized cottage cheese with strawberry and serve it with no chocolate and no coating. Offer it from twelve months as an occasional food.
